definitions.gloss: selfish; self-centered; doing as one pleases
definitions.explanation: Describes behavior or a person who acts according to their own wishes without considering others. Strongly negative in nuance.

examples.japanese: {自分勝手|じぶんかって}なことを{言|い}うな。
あの{人|ひと}はいつも{自分勝手|じぶんかって}に{行動|こうどう}する。
{自分勝手|じぶんかって}な{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}いばかりしていると、{友達|ともだち}がいなくなるよ。
examples.english: If you keep behaving selfishly, you'll lose all your friends.

notes:
A compound of {自分|じぶん} (oneself) and {勝手|かって} (one's own way). Describes someone who prioritizes their own desires without regard for how it affects others. It carries a clearly negative judgment.

USAGE:
Used as a na-adjective modifying nouns ({自分勝手|じぶんかって}な{人|ひと}) or adverbially with に ({自分勝手|じぶんかって}に{行動|こうどう}する). Also functions as a noun: {自分勝手|じぶんかって}はやめろ (stop being selfish).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自分勝手|じぶんかって}な{行動|こうどう} — selfish behavior
- {自分勝手|じぶんかって}な{人|ひと} — a selfish person
- {自分勝手|じぶんかって}に{決|き}める — to decide on one's own without consulting others

SIMILAR WORDS:
- わがまま — selfish, spoiled; often used for children or in intimate relationships
- {身勝手|みがって} — selfish; very close synonym, slightly more literary
- {利己的|りこてき} — egoistic; more formal and academic in tone
